title: Justified Evidence Collection for Argument-based AI Fairness Assurance
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI fairness assurance, framing fairness as a set of 'positive and negative moral duties' and 'societal values.' It develops a framework for 'Trustworthy and Ethical Assurance' (TEA) and evaluates ethical properties like fairness and bias through a case study involving a financial sentiment analysis LLM.
